A '''Jedi chapter house''' was located on the site of the [[Terril Naval Base]], on [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles's]] [[Esseles's southern continent|southern continent]]. It served as a staging point for [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] operations in the [[Darpa sector/Legends|Darpa sector]]. The site was destroyed after the [[Rise of the Empire era|Rise of the Empire]].<ref name="CatCW" />
